name: Law of Similarity
axiom: Elements that share colour, shape, or size are read as one kind of thing.
trigger: Two different kinds of control share a style, or one kind is drawn three different ways.

checklist.text: Give every primary action the same fill, radius, and weight; a variant is a different thing.
Draw metadata badges and filter pills in different shapes, not just different colours.
Reserve one accent colour for items that must stand apart from everything else.
Squint at a screen: if unlike things merge into blobs, the shared style is the defect.

antiPattern.violation: Submit buttons appear as blue pills, green rectangles, and outlines on different screens.
antiPattern.remediation: All primary actions use one token: same background, text colour, radius, and weight.

parametricParams.caption: ALIKE BY FORM, NOT BY PLACE

academicOrigin.title: Untersuchungen zur Lehre von der Gestalt II
